mapper.select: SELECT ac_idx, nickname, img, follower_count AS followerCount, following_count AS followingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note WHERE ac_idx = #{targetUserId}) AS postCount, CASE WHEN #{currentUserId} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE follower_ac_idx = #{currentUserId} AND followed_ac_idx = #{targetUserId}) END AS followedByCurrentUser FROM userAccount WHERE ac_idx = #{targetUserId}

SELECT note_idx, title, titleimg FROM ( SELECT note_idx, title, titleimg, ROWNUM as rn FROM ( SELECT note_idx, title, titleimg FROM note WHERE ac_idx = #{acIdx} AND parent_note_idx IS NULL ORDER BY create_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{criteria.pageNum} * #{criteria.amount} ) WHERE rn > (#{criteria.pageNum} - 1) * #{criteria.amount}
